name: Tanmiya for Real Estate Investment Co.
source: Starta Markets revenue and EPS plus AskBorsa gross profit and net profit, both compiled from EGX company disclosures, checked 15 Nov 2026 | EGXNOTE 17 Nov 2026: askborsa carries the published FY 2025 results for TANM with net profit of 34.82 million EGP -6.4% (https://askborsa.com/en/company/TANM/fy-2025). That English summary publishes net profit and gross profit only, not the ten income lines this panel renders, so no column was written rather than a year with two cells filled and eight blank.
note: Rebuilt 15 Nov 2026. Each year was accepted only where two independent compilers reproduced the same net profit within 1 percent (or 1,000 EGP) for that fiscal year, and revenue exceeded gross profit. Earlier Mubasher summary columns for this issuer did not reconcile with either compiler and were replaced. Cost of Sales is derived as Revenue minus Gross Profit.
